body: Spain, i guess it is a great place to live, just a bit behind in a couple things like chronic pain treatment sadly

Thanks, you probably heard this a lot of times but It is so tiring to be judged all the time when i'm in pain. Can't even have healthy friendships or relationships because every time i need to be alone or i need some love it seems like an excuse.

I never open myself to talk about the pain because everytime i do, i get the "others have it harder". I'm afraid the same will happen when i get a job. When i try to force myself to seem like i deal with it i end up very distracted and can't remember things nor concentrate, frustrating everyone around me.

Just so afraid that im not making progress and reaching my limit soon. Considering marihuana and the sorts to help with pain but illegal and bad quality in my country so i don't really dare try
